reviews_5s:
Rigid frame makes grating harder cheeses about easier as it doesn’t bend the plane.This works really well, and I like it better than the narrow ones that seem to trap whatever I'm grating. Well made and easier to clean.Works beautifully on parmesan. Expect it will with ginger, too. Easy to clean. Sturdy.Works great. Easy to clean. Used for cheese and zest. Great for hard cheeses.It was just finegood quality itemCitrus zesting and garlic mincing is a breeze with this tool.I bought the largest surface area I could find, and the smallest size cutting blades. This works terrific on Pecorino Romano, so it should work with all hard cheeses.My absolute favorite brand of microplanes and graters!

I use this one for grating hard cheeses into food I cook, especially if I want them to melt fast! Low effort grating every time!Great for grating ginger
reviews_1s:
What do you call a grater that doesn't grate? A Microplane Gourmet Series grater. This thing is dull and does not do the one thing it was designed to do. Can't even grate the softest vegetables.cheap and thin. looks and feels and is like a cheap plastic not quality. poor construction. avoid.It's welded to the sides very poorly. Mine broke after 2 months.Plastic film on the back of the grater, once removed, left a very sticky residue which would not come off even after a dishwasher cycle, scrubbing and rubbing with oil. Absolutely no idea why the manufacturer has used such an adhesive on an item for food preparation. ReturnedHad a sticker all over the blade that left industrial glue all over the device thats meant for food. Its impossible to remove and is over everything..
Cant refund it as i just found out (i havent used it for a month due to moving)Der Hersteller hat auf der Rückseite ganzflächige Klebeetiketten angebracht, deren Kleberückstände sich weder mit Nagellack-Entferner, noch Öl oder schrubben entfernen lassen. Es ist so unfassbar, wie man sein eigenes Produkt durch so einen Schwachsinn kaputt machen kann. Nie wieder Micropane. Bevor ich das Teil benutzen kann, muss ich stundenlang Kleber abschrubben. Dann lieber die billige Variante - die kann ich wenigstens sofort benutzen, ohne Kleber im Essen zu haben. Unfassbar.OK it's sharp and it grates, so deserves the one star for it that I'm forced to give to leave the review.

It's huge, bigger doesn't always mean better.
The grater part flexes a bit when using, which doesn't fill me with confidence that this will last a long time.
The grating part is not all one piece of moulded metal, which when washing meant I found that food debris got stuck down the join on each side. It was a pain to stand and clean out each side. My old one is all one piece of metal so food debris wasn't an issue.
The grater blade itself doesn't wash up easily, maybe because the grater holes are so tiny so food gets stuck.
We've used it once and washed twice and it's already showing a couple of scratches on the grating part.
I really dislike it already.
Items we buy generally are supposed to make life easier which unfortunately this doesn't.
My old morphy Richards one that I've had for years is so much better..Why would you put a sticker on the back of the grater that is high sticking and leaving glue all over a product that you use with food
UnbelievableNot great for treating hard cheese or chocolateVery disappointed with this because someone had stuck a very sticky label on the back of the grater. Don't know if it was the manufacturer or supplier. Foolishly we tried to take the label off and have been trying for the last few weeks to get rid of the glue. We should have sent it straight back but it was bought as a present. We have tried lots of solutions - its been soaked in vodka, and vinegar, been through the dishwasher and washed and scraped many times. Most of the glue has now gone so we have decided to use it. Its probably an excellent grater. But why does someone put a sticky label on and ruin it?
